import json, os, platform, secrets, tempfile, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
import cv2
import numpy as np
from robot import main
from robot.config import SHARED
from robot.settings import Settings
from robot.things import DIM
arm = 'baseline'
result = {'run':'ui-refresh', 'arm':arm, 'machine':platform.node(), 'release':os.environ['ROBOT_RELEASE'],
          'input':'oracle text and repeated fixture image; isolated memories',
          'tegrastats':os.environ['ROBOT_TEGRASTATS'], 'checks':{}, 'complete':False}
started=time.time()
os.environ['ROBOT_VIEW_TOKEN']=secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=SHARED) as temp:
    root=Path(temp)
    main.settings=Settings(root/'settings.json')
    frame=cv2.imread('eval/dev/images/m2-clock.jpg');assert frame is not None
    camera=SimpleNamespace(latest=lambda:(frame,time.time()))
    robot=main.Robot(camera,root/'audio',memory=root/'memory',wake_word=False)
    try:
        time.sleep(2)
        def ask(text):
            robot.ask(text);turn=robot.next_turn(timeout=90);assert turn.answer;return turn
        taught=ask('Track this as my clock');assert taught.named,taught.answer
        recalled=ask('Where is my clock?')
        url=f'http://127.0.0.1:{robot.video.port}';token=os.environ['ROBOT_VIEW_TOKEN']
        def get(path):
            with urllib.request.urlopen(url+path+(' & ' if '?' in path else '?').replace(' & ','&')+'token='+token,timeout=10) as response:return json.load(response)
        def post(path,data):
            request=urllib.request.Request(url+path+'?token='+token,data=json.dumps(data).encode(),headers={'Origin':url,'Content-Type':'application/json'})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=10) as response:assert response.status==202
        state=get('/state');item=next(m for m in state['evidence']['memories'] if m.get('object')==taught.named)
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url+'/thumb?view='+item['view']+'&token='+token) as response:assert response.read().startswith(b'\xff\xd8')
        result['checks']['evidence_and_thumbnail']=True
        timing=state['evidence'].get('timing');result['timing_fields']=timing
        if arm=='candidate':
            assert timing['first_text_ms']==round(1000*(recalled.first_token-recalled.speech_end),1)
            assert timing['speech_ready_ms']==round(1000*(recalled.first_audio-recalled.speech_end),1)
            result['checks']['turn_timings']=True
        def seed(faces,crops):
            owner=robot.things.shard.retrieve([taught.named],True,False)[0].payload['owner']
            robot.things.tell(owner,'Sam');other=robot.things.new_visitor()
            probe=robot.things.name(other,'probe',['camera'],np.eye(DIM,dtype=np.float32)[:3],[frame]*3,'Sam')
            return owner,other,probe
        owner,other,probe=robot.recognition.call(seed,mutate=True)
        objects=get('/memory');assert len(objects)==2
        assert all(obj['owner_label']=='Sam' for obj in objects)
        result['owner_fields']=all('owner' in obj for obj in objects)
        if arm=='candidate':
            assert {obj['owner'] for obj in objects}=={owner,other};result['checks']['independent_visitors']=True
        saved=next(obj for obj in objects if obj['id']==probe);removed=saved['views'][1]['id']
        post('/remove_view',{'object':probe,'view':removed});robot.jobs.join()
        after=next(obj for obj in get('/memory') if obj['id']==probe)
        assert len(after['views'])==len(saved['views'])-1 and removed not in [v['id'] for v in after['views']]
        result['checks']['queued_view_removal']=True
        post('/forget_object',{'object':taught.named});robot.jobs.join()
        assert all(obj['id']!=taught.named for obj in get('/memory'))
        assert not get('/state')['evidence']['memories']
        result['checks']['forget_clears_evidence']=True
        post('/forget_object',{'object':probe});robot.jobs.join();assert not get('/memory')
        result['checks']['forget_last_object']=True
        result['answers']=[taught.answer,recalled.answer]
    finally:robot.close()
result['elapsed_s']=time.time()-started;result['complete']=True;result['checks_passed']=all(result['checks'].values())
path=SHARED/'results'/f'{time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")}-ui-refresh-{arm}-{int(started)}.json'
path.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
